items.title: VRTX Tumbles After-Hours As FDA Delays Kidney Drug Decision; Rival VERA Surges
items.summary: Vertex said the FDA informed it on Tuesday that the deadline for deciding on its application seeking approval for its drug povetacicept in IgA nephropathy would be extended by up to three months.
